nodes.label: Context & Architecture Routing (Graphify + Obsidian + ICM)
nodes.rationale: Enforces structural discovery via graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md first, reading Obsidian devbrain memory notes second, and following ICM staged execution (.icm/CONTEXT.md) with user approval before editing code.

nodes.label: ICM Staged Execution (.icm/CONTEXT.md)
nodes.rationale: Requires multi-file features to follow 01_spec -> 02_plan -> 03_verify and stop at .icm/02_plan/output/plan.md for user approval.

nodes.label: Google OAuth Sign-In Transient Error Popup
nodes.norm_label: google oauth sign-in transient error popup
nodes.rationale: During login through Google Auth, a transient 'no account associated' error briefly pops up before sign-in completes and opens the app.

nodes.label: Total Net Balance Pagination Calculation Discrepancy
nodes.norm_label: total net balance pagination calculation discrepancy
nodes.rationale: App UI net balance calculation was non-uniform when not all transactions were loaded in list state, requiring scrolling to load all transactions, unlike the widget which queried the full actual balance.

nodes.label: Accurate Net Balance Engine
nodes.rationale: Calculates Total Net Balance as Sum(Account Starting Values) + Total Income - Total Expenses - Transfers (net zero across sub-accounts).

nodes.label: Release v0.1.0 (Initial Beta Release)
nodes.rationale: Established Personal Wallet mode with [wallet] marker, local-first Expo SQLite persistence (orgwallet.db), offline sync queue, and Total Net Balance calculation engine.

nodes.label: Release v0.2.0 (Live Android Home Screen Widget & Branding)
nodes.norm_label: release v0.2.0 (live android home screen widget & branding)
nodes.rationale: Engineered OrgWalletBalance native Android widget with 1-tap quick action shortcuts, wallpaper translucency control, and offline sync management UI.

nodes.label: Release v0.3.0 (Offline Transaction & Sub-Account Management)
nodes.rationale: Implemented offline-first transaction and sub-account editing/deletion, Rule #2 account deletion safeguard archiving accounts referenced by existing transactions, and SQLite FIFO mutex serialization (withLock) to prevent native Android statement collisions.

nodes.label: Release v0.4.1 (ProGuard Hotfix)
nodes.rationale: Added ProGuard keep rules for expo.modules.** to prevent AnyTypeCache minification crashes on Android launch, and fixed SyncEngine session hijack by supabaseAdmin.

nodes.label: Release v0.4.2 (Widget and UI Adjustments)
nodes.rationale: Relocated widget and background sync task registrations to global index.js so Android widget and background sync do not fail when the app is terminated in the background.

nodes.label: Release v0.4.3 (Web Support and Dynamic Currency)
nodes.norm_label: release v0.4.3 (web support and dynamic currency)
nodes.rationale: Added react-native-web compatibility with Metro WASM configuration, dynamic currency system across mobile UI and offline sync, Reanimated spring physics for transaction modals, and netinfo connectivity tracking.

nodes.label: Release v0.4.4 (Performance & UI Refinement)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilt Edit Transaction modal to match Add Transaction modal, introduced deep link navigation routes to bypass router fallback errors on cold starts, fixed Android ghost clicks with elevation and pointerEvents locking, and optimized list rendering via useCallback and SQL aggregation.

nodes.label: OrgWallet Overview & Architecture
nodes.rationale: Android-first React Native (Expo Router + TypeScript) companion app for OrgFinance Personal Wallet Mode with offline SQLite storage and Supabase synchronization.

nodes.label: Release Notes & Google Play Console Guide (v0.4.4)
nodes.norm_label: release notes & google play console guide (v0.4.4)
nodes.rationale: Documents release history from v0.1.0 to v0.4.4 (versionCode 9) and provides instructions for building signed Android App Bundles (.aab) via Gradle/EAS and publishing to Google Play Console.

nodes.label: SQLite FIFO Mutex Serialization (withLock)
nodes.rationale: Wraps all SQLite CRUD and count operations in asynchronous FIFO mutex locks to prevent native Android SQLite statement collisions.

nodes.label: Rule #1: Organization Membership Guards
nodes.rationale: Security access queries strictly verify organization ownership (owner_id = userId) and active membership (organization_members.user_id = userId AND is_active = true) without brittle single-row assumptions.

nodes.label: Rule #2: Smart Personal Wallet Resolution & Account Deletion Safeguard
nodes.norm_label: rule #2: smart personal wallet resolution & account deletion safeguard
nodes.rationale: Automatically detects Personal Wallet organization (is_wallet = true or [wallet] marker), spawns a default Cash sub-account, hides multi-user business features, and forbids hard-deleting referenced sub-accounts in favor of archiving (is_active = false).

nodes.label: Java 25 to OpenJDK 21 Gradle Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Gradle 8.14.3 does not support Java 25 (major version 69), so org.gradle.java.home is configured to point to OpenJDK 21.
